title: Republicans are Panicking
speaker: Kevin Paffrath

macro_themes.view: Anti-AI/data-center sentiment is hurting Republicans; without an Iran deal Democrats almost certainly sweep.
Confident Trump signs an Iran deal between Oct 20 and 27, which would favour a split Congress.
Called the top in the 10-year at ~5.27% and is confident it holds even after hot CPI/PPI.
If no Iran deal and Democrats sweep, it's time to buy solar plays; data centers get delayed, not stopped.

calls.reason: Stands by his call that ~5.27% was the top in the 10-year, plus or minus five basis points, despite hot CPI and PPI.
calls.quote: I'm confident that this is the top on the 10-year. And it was.

notes: Mostly political. Conditional solar bullishness (if no Iran deal by Oct 27) has no specific ticker - kept as a macro theme only.
